item.title: LVGL vs Slint vs Nuklear in 2026: Which Embedded GUI Toolkit Should You Actually Use?
item.description: Your device ships with a 320x240 display, 256 KB of RAM, and a project manager who wants the UI done yesterday. On the proprietary side, TouchGFX, emWin and Crank Storyboard all want per-seat licenses and NDA paperwork before you can read the docs. On the open side, three toolkits dominate every forum thread: LVGL, Slint and Nuklear. Picking wrong costs you months — a widget set that cannot fit your memory budget, or a project that stopped receiving commits in 2020.
